integrity: The derivation starts from the source's printed Equation (6), rank-one coexistence identities, Cramer formulas, and definition P_G=-Delta F_G. The universal degree bound is algebraic. A bundled exact-rational checker reconstructs a positive parameter example with a nonzero cubic coefficient and verifies P_G=-Delta F_G at rational test points.
scientific_limitations: The result corrects the algebraic degree and does not solve the full feasible root-count classification.
Feasible coexistence roots must additionally lie in the source interval (s_Delta, min{s1,s2}).
The related Gavish-Rabiu preprint is withdrawn and is used only as historical context, not as a correctness premise.
No stability classification of interior coexistence roots is asserted.
title: The Gavish coexistence polynomial is cubic, not quartic
